args:
DATA="$PGS_PLUGIN_DATA"; if [ -z "$DATA" ]; then DATA="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA"; fi; if [ -z "$DATA" ]; then BASE="$XDG_DATA_HOME"; if [ -z "$BASE" ]; then BASE="$HOME/.local/share"; fi; DATA="$BASE/pgs-plugin"; fi; VERSION="0.6.0"; BINARY="$DATA/bin/pgs-mcp"; VERSION_FILE="$DATA/VERSION"; needs_install() { INSTALLED_VERSION=""; if [ -r "$VERSION_FILE" ]; then INSTALLED_VERSION="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$VERSION_FILE")"; fi; [ ! -x "$BINARY" ] || [ "$INSTALLED_VERSION" != "$VERSION" ]; }; if needs_install; then mkdir -p "$DATA" || exit 127; LOCK_DIR="$DATA/.install.lock"; HAVE_LOCK=0; while [ "$HAVE_LOCK" -eq 0 ]; do if mkdir "$LOCK_DIR" 2>/dev/null; then HAVE_LOCK=1; trap 'rmdir "$LOCK_DIR"' EXIT INT TERM; elif needs_install; then sleep 0.1; else break; fi; done; if [ "$HAVE_LOCK" -eq 1 ] && needs_install; then OS="$(uname -s)"; ARCH="$(uname -m)"; case "$OS:$ARCH" in Darwin:*) BINARY_NAME="pgs-mcp-universal-apple-darwin" ;; Linux:x86_64) BINARY_NAME="pgs-mcp-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl" ;; Linux:aarch64) BINARY_NAME="pgs-mcp-aarch64-unknown-linux-musl" ;; MINGW*:x86_64|MSYS*:x86_64|CYGWIN*:x86_64) BINARY_NAME="pgs-mcp-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe" ;; *) printf 'pgs-mcp: unsupported platform: %s %s
' "$OS" "$ARCH" >&2; exit 127 ;; esac; if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'pgs-mcp: curl is required to install pgs-mcp %s
' "$VERSION" >&2; exit 127; fi; mkdir -p "$DATA/bin" || exit 127; URL="https://github.com/UtsavBalar1231/pgs/releases/download/v$VERSION/$BINARY_NAME"; TMP_BINARY="$DATA/bin/.pgs-mcp.$$.tmp"; TMP_VERSION="$DATA/.VERSION.$$.tmp"; rm -f "$TMP_BINARY" "$TMP_VERSION"; printf 'pgs-mcp: downloading %s
' "$URL" >&2; if ! curl -fsSL "$URL" -o "$TMP_BINARY"; then rm -f "$TMP_BINARY" "$TMP_VERSION"; exit 127; fi; chmod +x "$TMP_BINARY" || { rm -f "$TMP_BINARY" "$TMP_VERSION"; exit 127; }; mv -f "$TMP_BINARY" "$BINARY" || { rm -f "$TMP_BINARY" "$TMP_VERSION"; exit 127; }; printf '%s
' "$VERSION" > "$TMP_VERSION" || { rm -f "$TMP_VERSION"; exit 127; }; mv -f "$TMP_VERSION" "$VERSION_FILE" || { rm -f "$TMP_VERSION"; exit 127; }; fi; if [ "$HAVE_LOCK" -eq 1 ]; then rmdir "$LOCK_DIR"; trap - EXIT INT TERM; fi; fi; exec "$BINARY" "$@"
